history.summary: NON-HINDU: Mahamuni is a BUDDHIST pagoda, not a Hindu temple - needs a keep/drop decision for the temples dataset. Located at Manu Bankul (Manubankul) in Rupaichhari block, Sabroom sub-division, South Tripura, about 25 km from Sabroom town and 134 km from Agartala. Modelled on the famous Mahamuni Pagoda of Mandalay, Myanmar, it is a shrine of repute drawing Buddhist pilgrims from Thailand, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Japan and Bangladesh, per Tripura Tourism. The annual five-day Bankul Mahamuni Buddha Festival was in its 78th edition in March 2025 (March 13-17), when Chief Minister Dr. Manik Saha unveiled 28 Buddha statues on the premises. The state government is developing Bankul as a tourist destination and building an International Buddhist University in Sabroom. CSV TOWN FLAG: the CSV town 'Sabroom' is the sub-division; the pagoda is at Manu Bankul, ~25 km from Sabroom town - town corrected to Manubankul (Sabroom sub-division).

town_description: Manu Bankul (Manubankul) is a village in Rupaichhari block, Sabroom sub-division of South Tripura district, about 25 km from Sabroom town near the Bangladesh border. It is known for the Mahamuni Buddhist pagoda, the Mahamuni Tourist Lodge, and the annual Bankul Mahamuni Buddha Festival.
